instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched ZBrush graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ZScript files, Python, macros, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only ZBrush native GUI tools, menus, brushes, and built-in export commands. Multi-SubTool Character export + Multi Map Exporter The opened `scene.obj` is a 2-SubTool character: SubTool Head - sphere radius 0.5 at center (0, 0.6, 0), lat-lon 16x32 (512 quads, 561 verts), MRGB polypaint, UVs. SubTool Body - cylinder side radius 0.3 x height 0.8 at origin, 256 quads, 297 verts, MRGB polypaint, UVs. Load the OBJ into ZBrush preserving SubTool hierarchy, UVs, and polypaint. Export the scene plus three 2048x2048 baked maps via Multi Map Exporter. Outputs: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Character.obj` - two SubTools named Head and Body with MRGB and UVs preserved. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Normal.png` - 2048x2048 RGB tangent-space normal map. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Displacement.png` - 2048x2048 16-bit grayscale displacement. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Cavity.png` - 2048x2048 8-bit grayscale cavity. Requirements: - All four files exist. - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Character.obj` contains exactly 2 SubTools named Head and Body; both have MRGB and UVs. - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Normal.png` is 2048x2048 RGB with mean B-channel value > 0.5. - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Displacement.png` is 2048x2048 single-channel grayscale, bit-depth >= 16, unique values >= 1000, mean deviation from 0.5 < 0.2. - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Cavity.png` is 2048x2048 single-channel grayscale with >= 50% non-zero pixels.

import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
